Package org.apache.wiki.notification

Class DefaultSubscriptionManager

java.lang.Object
org.apache.wiki.notification.DefaultSubscriptionManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventListener, Initializable, WikiEventListener, SubscriptionManager
public class DefaultSubscriptionManager extends Object implements SubscriptionManager, Initializable, WikiEventListener
Default implementation of SubscriptionManager. It listens to the end of the post-save filtering and sends an e-mail to every user that is subscribed to the saved page and has an e-mail address in the profile.

The mails are sent from a single background thread, so saving a page never waits for the mail server. The mail does not contain the text of the page. The links in the mails are made absolute with the property "jspwiki.subscription.baseURL", since no request is available here. Pages with an ACL on the view permission are not notified, since the view permission of an offline user cannot be evaluated here.

Since:
3.0.1
